world_model_delta: RESOURCE_SCARCITY triggers when a faction's total resource stockpile across all islands falls below 5 units for 3 consecutive turns. Scarcity activates a 50% resource production bonus for that faction for 3 turns. Scarcity is a catch-up mechanic.
validator_question: Does scarcity bonus create a governance exemption for the affected faction?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — catch-up bonus only, no governance exemption
